The three surf weeks cost the same, per person for seven nights. That is the base price the booking engine showed on 28 September 2026. The room you choose can add to it; the engine shows any supplement once you pick your dates.

What's included

Packages start on a Saturday and run for 7, 14, 21 or 28 nights, for up to six guests per booking. Drinking water and local coffee and tea are unlimited.

  • 7 nights' accommodation
  • 7 breakfasts
  • 5 dinners
  • 5 guided surf sessions of 2 hours
  • 5 surf theory lessons
  • Unlimited surf equipment all week
  • Walk or ride to the surf, depending on the spot
  • A cultural or nature excursion
  • Unlimited drinking water
  • Unlimited local coffee and tea

The lodge

There are just twelve rooms. That keeps a stay here personal, part of one big happy family.

When you're not on the water, lie out on a sunbed by the pool under the palms, hang out in the common area, take an ice-cold drink from the bar, or eat Sri Lankan produce from the lodge kitchen.

  • Outdoor swimming pool
  • Yoga chalet
  • Yoga, meditation and sound healing sessions
  • Ice baths
  • Lookout terraceocean view
  • Restaurantbreakfast, lunch and dinner, daily
  • Bar
  • Gluten-free and vegan options
  • Co-working spacehigh-speed internet, coffee and fresh juices
  • Free WiFi
  • Airport shuttle
  • Free private parking on site
  • Non-smoking rooms
  • Garden
  • Sun terrace

Our rooms

Every room has air conditioning, a ceiling fan, a safe box, a private toilet and shower, a socket next to each bed and, of course, a board rack.

Mixed dorm room – 4 beds

Our new gallery room sleeps four in comfortable single beds and has its own outdoor bathroom. It suits larger groups, and travellers on a budget.

Sleeps 4 | 4 single beds | Private outdoor bathroom | Shared

Shared Twin Room – 2 Beds

The twin rooms look out on the beach all day, and each has a lovely private bathroom. There are two beds; the room is shared unless you choose private use on the booking page.

Getting here
